original_question:
Implement a 4-bit synchronous up counter in Verilog.

Your module should be named `up_counter`.

The module must accept two single-bit inputs: `clk` (the clock signal) and `rst` (a synchronous active-high reset).

The module must produce a 4-bit registered output named `count`, which holds the current counter value.

The counter should increment its value by one on every rising edge of `clk`, unless the `rst` signal is asserted high.

When `rst` is high, the counter should synchronously reset its value to 0 on the next rising edge of `clk`.
